data.name: Psychic Defense
data.description: Humans from cultures steeped in the occult sometimes train their minds to resist outside influence. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against psychic spells and spell-like abilities, including those that originate from the psychic magic ability (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 5 297). This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.
